Shows this enemy's repeating move order. The Merchant??? is not a normal map enemy . It is the combat half of the Fake Merchant guide . The event itself only becomes eligible from Act 2 onward, is single-player only, and requires the player to have at least 100 gold or at least one Foul Potion .

The actual condition for facing this enemy is using a Foul Potion during the Fake Merchant event , which flips the counterfeit shop into combat.

When the event starts, it stocks 6 random fake relics from a 9-relic counterfeit pool. Their source base cost is 50, but the displayed shop prices are not best described as a flat fixed 50 in practice. The safer player-facing takeaway is that these fake relics are sold well below normal relic pricing, and because they use separate relic IDs they can coexist with the original relic versions.

moves.notes: Always followed by Explode. No transition in the current official state machine leads to this move. It exists in source, but does not trigger in the normal sequence.
